::: {.software-header}
::: {}
HapApp checks a raw DArTag Missing Allele Discovery Count (MADC) report, filters rare microhaplotypes, and compares each one with Breeding Insight's microhaplotype database for your species. Known microhaplotypes keep their established IDs and new ones receive new unique IDs.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::
<img class="software-logo" src="../assets/software-hapapp.png" alt="HapApp logo">
:::

## Start here

HapApp runs online, with no software to install. Access is limited to registered users; to request access, email [bi-science-team@ufl.edu](mailto:bi-science-team@ufl.edu?subject=HapApp%20access%20request).

[{{< meta access >}}]{.access-note}

## Good fit for

- Processing raw DArTag MADC reports with fixed microhaplotype IDs
- Combining microhaplotype data across years and projects
- Preparing MADC files for downstream analysis in BIGr and BIGapp
